items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: And in between where the parking lot is, right from the lady's club, that was a Tom Anderson's.

ctx.x: And you take where the lowest state, that used to be a barber shop on that corner. Right on the canal. And you take where the lowest state, that used to be a barber shop on that corner. Right on the canal. That used to be a bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo So she might not remember too much about what the city was like too far away?

Oh, I remember pretty good. I shined shoes, I was all in the house. So you take where Cotton's jewelry store, that used to be a barber shop on that corner. Right on the canal. And you take where the Lois State, that used to be a shooting gallery. And where the Sanger is now, that was something like a mummy. You used to go in there and look at all kinds of rubber and wax mummies. And where the F.W. Woolwork, that was a candy store. And coming down toward the Iberville, that was a hardware store. And in between…
